data.name: RootDescription
data.value: Scudo Digitale: free, open-source security self-assessment of your network, Wi-Fi, websites, email, Bluetooth, GDPR and NIS2. Runs locally: no data leaves your computer.

data.name: Disclaimer
data.value: This is a self-assessment tool: it does not replace a penetration test or legal advice. Use it only on systems you own or are authorized to check.

data.name: UsageHint
data.value: Version 0.0: no checks are available yet. Run "scudo --help" to see the options.
